item.text:
Refactored the app into cleaner layers without changing behavior:

- [backend/index.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/backend/index.js#L1) now only handles bootstrapping.
- [backend/app.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/backend/app.js#L1) owns Express setup and middleware wiring.
- [backend/routes/comments.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/backend/routes/comments.js#L1) owns the comments endpoint.
- [frontend/src/styles.css](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/styles.css#L1) now holds all page styles instead of inline HTML.
- [frontend/src/main.jsx](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/main.jsx#L1) imports the stylesheet.
- [frontend/src/CommentRow.jsx](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/CommentRow.jsx#L1) now delegates date formatting to [frontend/src/formatters.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/formatters.js#L1).
- [frontend/index.html](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/index.html#L1) is back to a minimal document shell.

Validation:
- `node --check` passed for all backend `.js` files.
- `git diff --check` is clean.
- I could not do a real frontend build/syntax pass here because the workspace doesn’t include the frontend toolchain manifest, so JSX wasn’t runnable in this environment.

If you want another pass, the next clean seam is either:
1. Collapse the remaining model boilerplate into a small model registry helper.
2. Turn the demo slug into a prop/config value instead of a hardcoded constant.
